newsitem.title: USA: U.S. barley weekly export sales highlights -- USDA.
newsitem.headline: U.S. barley weekly export sales highlights -- USDA.

text.p: USDA barley export sales highlights in latest reporting week:
Net sales of 21,800 MT resulted as major increases for Japan (20,600 MT) and Saudi Arabia (14,800 MT, switched from unknown) were partly offset by decreases for unknown destinations (14,800 MT).

Exports of 62,100 MT were down 18 percent from the prior week, but up 6 percent from the 4-week average. The major destinations were Cyprus (26,200 MT), Japan (20,600 MT), and Saudi Arabia (14,800 MT).
